blocks.text: INQUIRER.net / Updated as of: 08:43 AM September 21, 2026

MANILA, Philippines – Various groups are set to hold rallies, marches and commemorative activities across the country on Monday as the Philippines marks the 54th anniversary of the declaration of martial law.

items: In Metro Manila, protesters are expected to gather at Liwasang Bonifacio before proceeding toward Mendiola, while other activities are planned at the EDSA Shrine, People Power Monument and other areas.

Authorities have tightened security around expected protest sites and Malacañang, with more than 17,000 police personnel deployed across Metro Manila. The Malacañang complex is under heightened security, with the New Executive Building and Presidential Action Center closed Monday, while access to roads and gates leading to the Palace is restricted.

Face-to-face classes in public and private schools at all levels in Manila are suspended on Monday, Sept. 21, due to security concerns over rallies and other activities marking the 54th anniversary of the declaration of Martial Law
